title.narrative: Interest Rate Subsidies on Macro Financial Assistance Loans (MFA+) provided by the EU to Ukraine

description.narrative:
Extrabudgetary contribution to the EU to cover interest payments by Ukraine on loans received from the EU
EU’s macroeconomic loan to Ukraine of 18 bn EUR in 2023- together with assistance from other international donors - will be an element of enabling Ukraine to maintain macroeconomic stability, as well as sustaining resilience and social fabric by continuing to finance expenditures for key social areas such as education, health, and pensions.
